description: Leadfeeder identifies the B2B companies visiting your website and enriches them with firmographics, contacts, intent signals, and CRM data. Revenue teams use it to prioritise outreach, discover buyer contacts, track campaign performance, and action accounts into lists and tags — all through natural-language queries.
